name: TX-01
label: Safe R

model.rationale: The R+24 district, incumbent advantage, and Moran's large fundraising edge over a challenger with under $10,000 raised all point to a safe Republican hold; markets agree at roughly 2% for Democrats.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or national Democratic wave could tighten the race, though the district's lean makes an upset very unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Nathaniel Moran seeks a second term in this deep-east Texas district, which carries a Republican lean of about 24 points. He was renominated without difficulty and enters the general election with a large financial advantage, having raised nearly $1.8 million and holding over $775,000 on hand.

Democrat Yolanda Prince faces steep odds, with minimal fundraising of about $9,000 and no outside support on record. No public polls track the race, but prediction markets give Democrats only a small chance. The fundamentals and the district's partisan makeup make this a safe Republican seat.
